Name: SDVE Unique Furry Sprites
Author: brightonmorris1
Description:
I like SDVE and Anthro Characters Continued, but some of the portraits in the conversion patch bothered me/weren't done. A few of the villagers recycled sprites from ACC and didn't keep their "vibe". 

So I fixed it.

I drew some portraits using their sprites from SDVE as a base and then did my best to select an animal that felt appropriate for their personality.

Victor is a crow, Olivia is a secretary bird, Suki is still a fox, Scarlett is a Capybara, and Lance is still a deer but this time he has shading.

Latest update features Susan as a cow and Martin as a mouse.

Soon everyone will be finished, I'm getting closer every day!

[b]If you've drawn something and would like it added, there's like a 94% chance I will add it + do touch ups + credit you. Feel free to chat me up for furry related Stardew Valley questions.[/b]

Credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for their artwork, which was used as the base for the sprites.

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/98972058]FeralBloom[/url]﻿ for the lance overworld sprites!

Other peeps who made this possible! RT_Girl, Lycanglass, and everyone behind SDVE in general.
